summary: Boston Scientific filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026 reporting that Joe Fitzgerald, currently EVP and Group President, Cardiovascular, was promoted to EVP and Chief Operating Officer effective January 1, 2027. The 63-year-old joined the company in 1990 and has led cardiovascular units. Terms include a $1,050,000 base salary, 110% bonus target, deferred bonus eligibility up to 75%, and a 2027 equity award with $7,000,000 grant date fair value. No board recommendation or advisor named. Succession timing and Fitzgerald's strategic influence over cardiovascular operations are watch items.
